Photo Video Maker for Beginners — Initial Release

- Launches a beginner-friendly tool to turn JPG, PNG, HEIC, and WebP photos (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 slideshow videos.
- Handles session setup, file uploads, and rendering on cloud GPUs; delivers videos in 30–60 seconds.
- No local installation or advanced editing knowledge required—just drop in your photos and describe the desired video.
- Supports common video features: background music, transitions, text overlays, and export in multiple formats.
- Automatically manages user tokens and sessions for a seamless, guided experience.
- Provides clear error handling, progress updates, and workflow tips for optimal results.
